AccountFactsResponse.description:
§9 insight 8 — the facts that raise the stakes on everything else.

From reference data, not from the pipeline, so nothing here depends on
extraction agreement.

annualPremium.description: Null when not recorded — never zero.
annualPremium.title: Annualpremium

AccountFactsResponse.title: AccountFactsResponse

risk.description: This account's risk standing, the same shape as on the risk screen.

calls.description: Calls for this employer in the window.
calls.title: Calls

evidence.description: Every call behind every condition that fired.
evidence.title: Evidence

quotable.description: Whether there are enough calls to quote this as a figure.
quotable.title: Quotable

state.description: What the page says, computed from the numbers. Read this rather than recombining the booleans: 'not eligible' is not 'not at risk'.
state.title: State

ActionItemResponse.description: One finding. No status — see this module's docstring.

ownerTeam.description: From the Signal Taxonomy's Owner column, which the sheet calls mandatory.
ownerTeam.title: Ownerteam

ActionItemResponse.title: ActionItemResponse

controlExceptions.description: Metric 7 by type. Never blended into one compliance rate.
controlExceptions.title: Controlexceptions

didItWork.description: Insight 22, withheld until a comparable before and after exist.

items.description: Every signal raised, worst severity first and heaviest within a severity. A signal nobody raised is absent, not present at zero.
items.title: Items

owners.description: The same items routed, teams with critical work first.
owners.title: Owners

AgentQualityResponse.description: Metric 12 as a range, never as a ranking position.

caveat.description: Computed from this agent's own n. Says plainly that a distribution this small cannot separate one agent from another.
caveat.title: Caveat

medianScore.description: Median, not mean. Null when no call was scored.
medianScore.title: Medianscore

AgentQualityResponse.title: AgentQualityResponse

escalationsMissed.description: Calls where an explicit escalation request went nowhere.
escalationsMissed.title: Escalationsmissed

knowledgeErrors.description: Calls where this agent stated a published rule incorrectly.
knowledgeErrors.title: Knowledgeerrors

agents.description: Agents with calls in the window, by reference.
agents.title: Agents

qualityWindowWeeks.description: Null: a quality score is a property of the call, not of a period, so the Metrics sheet gives metric 12 no window.
qualityWindowWeeks.title: Qualitywindowweeks

windowWeeks.description: The period the events are counted over.
windowWeeks.title: Windowweeks

AppliedFilterResponse.description: One active filter, for the applied-filters row.
AppliedFilterResponse.title: AppliedFilterResponse

byTouchpoint.description: Adverse mentions by where the failure originated, worst first.
byTouchpoint.title: Bytouchpoint

ratePerHundredLives.description: Secondary sort only, never a headline. Null for a book under the floor.

agency.description: What a reader calls this broker.
agency.title: Agency

name.description: The individual contact, not the agency.
name.title: Name

calls.description: Calls in the slice, which `hits` is not a share of.
calls.title: Calls

CodedValue.description:
One coded value and the words for it.

`code` is what a filter accepts and what a client branches on; `label`
is what a person reads. They are never the same field.

code.description: The stable identifier. Filters take this value.
code.title: Code

label.description: Display wording. Never branch on it — it may be reworded.
label.title: Label

CodedValue.title: CodedValue

ComponentStatus.description: Outcome of probing a single component.
ComponentStatus.title: ComponentStatus

ConditionResponse.description: One of metric 10's four conditions, met or not.

callIds.description: The calls that fired it. Empty when it did not.
callIds.title: Callids

ConditionResponse.title: ConditionResponse

CountResponse.description:
One cut of the failures. `value` carries its own label where the
thing being counted is a coded value rather than free text.
CountResponse.title: CountResponse

complaintsAboutUs.description: Complaints attributed to Choice. A different measure from self-inflicted demand, deliberately kept apart.

promiseGaps.description: Proposed changes at the enrolment touchpoints, most-proposed first.
promiseGaps.title: Promisegaps

unattributed.description: Calls with no touchpoint tagged — insight 18's residual bucket.
unattributed.title: Unattributed

EmergingResponse.description:
One value of some attribute, counted across equal slices.

Counts, never shares. At about eight calls a week a share would be two or
three calls, so a percentage would imply precision the corpus cannot
support.

For a multi-valued attribute — a call may raise several signals — the
hits across keys sum to more than the calls in the slice. That is why
each bucket reports `calls` beside `hits` instead of leaving a reader to
treat the two as comparable.
EmergingResponse.title: EmergingResponse

brokerRef.description: Broker of record, for a dependent filter.
brokerRef.title: Brokerref

asOf.description: The date every window on this screen ends on.
asOf.title: Asof

calls.description: Calls in the longest window on the screen, which contains every other. Never the sample behind any one figure — read that figure's own `n`.
calls.title: Calls

escalation.description: Both escalation views, in reading order. Handled over warranted is the control measure; warranted over all calls is its scale. Shown together because either alone misleads.
escalation.title: Escalation

intentRouted.description: Always withheld on v9 data: whether commercial intent reached anyone who could act on it is not a field. Zero would claim we checked.

trends.description: What moved since the equal-length window before, and what is emerging. Separate from `metrics` because these are not the Metrics sheet's figures.

premiumIncomplete.description: True when a flagged account has no premium recorded, so this is a floor.
premiumIncomplete.title: Premiumincomplete

FigureResponse.description: One number and everything needed to judge it.

basis.description: Where the number came from, and only that — never whether it is shown. OBSERVED: counted from the Call Tag Schema's own fields. DERIVED: our composite rather than a workbook field, and labelled as such wherever it surfaces. REFERENCE: an account fact from the workbook, not from a call. Null only on a withheld figure with no origin to name — a question the v9 schema has no field for. Branch on `published` for suppression.

callIds.description: The calls behind the figure, so it can be argued with. Present on withheld figures too: a reader told four calls is too few should still be able to open those four.
callIds.title: Callids

caveats.description: Generated from the numbers, never hand-written.
caveats.title: Caveats

n.description: The sample behind the figure. Equals the number of call ids.
n.title: N

published.description: False when the figure is withheld. Withheld means nobody has enough evidence to state a number, which is not the same as a number of zero.
published.title: Published

value.description: The figure, or null when it is withheld. Null is never zero: see `published`, which is the field to branch on.
value.title: Value

FigureResponse.title: FigureResponse

FilterOptionsResponse.description: Every value the filter bar can offer, by where it came from.

agentRefs.description: Observed on calls, not reference data, so this grows as more calls are analysed. References only — agent names are not available to this layer.
agentRefs.title: Agentrefs

brokers.description: From reference data. Every broker, including those with no calls.
brokers.title: Brokers

corpusPeriod.description: The first and last dated call available. The period control needs it to offer weeks and months: a client cannot name a week of a corpus whose extent it does not know. Null when no call carries a date.

employers.description: From reference data. Every employer, including those with no calls.
employers.title: Employers

touchpoints.description: Observed on calls, not reference data. Grows with the corpus.
touchpoints.title: Touchpoints

unlabelledFilters.description: Filters whose values have no display wording anywhere — not here, not in the workbook. A client must render the code. Named rather than silently omitted, so the gap is visible instead of being filled by invented text.
unlabelledFilters.title: Unlabelledfilters

FilterOptionsResponse.title: FilterOptionsResponse

rankedBrokers.description: Only books clearing the ranking floor in lives, worst count first.
rankedBrokers.title: Rankedbrokers

systemic.description: Categories present in every region. A presence test, not a volume threshold — it names the columns worth reading first, nothing more.
systemic.title: Systemic

windowWeeks.description: One window across the whole screen, so every cell counts the same period.
windowWeeks.title: Windowweeks

counts.description: Every category, including at zero. Zero is a real count here — call volume has no min n — and the columns must line up across rows for the dark-column reading to work.
counts.title: Counts

MetricFigureResponse.description: One published metric, with the window it was computed over.

name.description: The Metrics sheet's own name for it.
name.title: Name

windowWeeks.description: How far back this metric looks from `as_of`. Metrics on one screen differ; null means the metric is not windowed at all.
windowWeeks.title: Windowweeks

MetricFigureResponse.title: MetricFigureResponse

MovementResponse.description:
One measure's change, and whether the change means anything.

`beyondNoise` is the only field a screen should branch on. `now` and
`prior` alone will differ almost every period, and reporting every
difference is how a reader learns to ignore the screen.

beyondNoise.description: Whether the move exceeds what call volume explains. Branch on this.
beyondNoise.title: Beyondnoise

callsNow.description: Calls in the later window, the volume `expected` scales by.
callsNow.title: Callsnow

expected.description: What the later window would have shown if nothing changed except how many calls came in.
expected.title: Expected

worse.description: Whether the move is in the bad direction for this measure. Direction is not meaning: unresolved rising is bad, resolved rising is good.
worse.title: Worse

MovementResponse.title: MovementResponse

ObservationResponse.description: One indicator family's standing. Informational — it does not set the flag.

available.description: False when v9 has no field for this family. Not the same as no hits.
available.title: Available

rate.description: Null when the family cannot be computed, never zero.
rate.title: Rate

ObservationResponse.title: ObservationResponse

calls.description: Distinct calls behind this team's items. One call raising two signals for the same team counts once.
calls.title: Calls

PatternTestResponse.description: Trigger rule 2, reported whether or not it fired.

reached.description: What the test reached, computed from the numbers, fired or not.
reached.title: Reached

PatternTestResponse.title: PatternTestResponse

band.description: The size band, in lives. Null when the employer fits none.
band.title: Band

difference.description: The employer against its peers, as a proportion: 0.25 is '+25% vs peers'. Null when either side is missing — render that as 'no comparison available', never as 0%.
difference.title: Difference

peerMedian.description: Median contact rate of publishable peers. Null when the band has none.
peerMedian.title: Peermedian

peers.description: Employers behind the median. A median of two is not forty.
peers.title: Peers

PeriodResponse.description:
The requested period, echoed so a reader can see what was asked for.

Separate from each metric's `windowWeeks`, and deliberately so: the two
are different things (decision D11), and collapsing them into one field
is what would let a twelve-week rate be read as a three-week one.

from.description: Earliest call date included. Null means unbounded.
from.title: From

to.description: Latest call date included. Null means unbounded.
to.title: To

PeriodResponse.title: PeriodResponse

dynamicKinds.description: Key prefixes resolved per value, e.g. tp_denial_letter_eob.
dynamicKinds.title: Dynamickinds

heldBack.description: Prototype keys deliberately not shipped, and the decision that holds each.
heldBack.title: Heldback

claim.description: Always a recommendation, never a measurement (D14, C3a).
claim.title: Claim

dynamic.description: Built from a template for one touchpoint, category, signal or product line.
dynamic.title: Dynamic

ownerTeam.description: The suggested owner. For a touchpoint or signal key this is the workbook's own owner (Touchpoints sheet, Signal Taxonomy).
ownerTeam.title: Ownerteam

reviewed.description: Whether the owning teams have reviewed these steps. False until they do.
reviewed.title: Reviewed

source.description: The kind of action this issue produces, when it produces one.
source.title: Source

minutes.description: Talk time across those calls — a floor, since AHT excludes hold and after-call work.
minutes.title: Minutes

assessed.description: Only employers the window could speak about, most indicators first and then soonest renewal (D12). Narrowed by `flagged` and `minIndicators`.
assessed.title: Assessed

assessedCount.description: How many employers were assessed **before** `flagged` and `minIndicators` narrowed the list. Filters slice, never hide: a reader has to be able to tell a narrow screen from an empty one.
assessedCount.title: Assessedcount

flaggedShare.description: Flagged as a share of the *eligible* employers, never of all of them.

ineligible.description: Employers below the eligibility floor, by reference. Kept apart from `assessed` on purpose: too few calls to assess is not a finding of low risk, and at current volume most of the book is here.
ineligible.title: Ineligible

windowWeeks.description: Metric 10's window, in weeks, ending on `as_of`.
windowWeeks.title: Windowweeks

RuleRowResponse.description: One rule and the calls that got it wrong. No rate — see the module docstring.

commonlyConfusedWith.description: The Rules sheets' own column — what people mistake this rule for.
commonlyConfusedWith.title: Commonlyconfusedwith

confidence.description: The rule's own provenance grade from the Rules sheets. Provenance of the rule, not of any figure about it, and not an epistemic class.

layer.description: Program, Administration or Carrier — whose rulebook it is.

RuleRowResponse.title: RuleRowResponse

byProvenance.description: A misstated UNVERIFIED rule says our source is weak; a misstated VERIFIED one says our training is.
byProvenance.title: Byprovenance

byTouchpoint.description: Where the failure originated — the same rule in two documents is two fixes.
byTouchpoint.title: Bytouchpoint

overallRate.description: Metric 8: calls carrying a knowledge failure, over all calls. About the corpus, never about one rule.

rules.description: The rewrite list, worst first. Every rule, including those with no failures.
rules.title: Rules

ScopeResponse.description:
The population a response's figures were computed over.

Both counts are here because either alone misleads. `matched` without
`considered` hides how much of the corpus was set aside; `considered`
without `unmeasurable` makes a shortfall look like a narrower question
when it is really a field extraction never filled.

caveats.description: Whole-corpus caveats: undated calls, unanalysed calls, and schema fields the pipeline cannot produce.
caveats.title: Caveats

corpusPeriod.description: The full extent of dated calls available, ignoring the requested period. This is what a period control offers: without it a client that has narrowed once has no way to know what it narrowed from. Null when no call carries a date.

excludedCalls.description: Stored calls that reached no figure at all — no date, or never analysed. Counted before filtering.
excludedCalls.title: Excludedcalls

period.description: The period the caller asked for, echoed back. Null at either end means that end was unbounded. It bounds which calls were read and does not narrow any metric's own window — see `caveats`.

sources.description: Transcript origins included. Empty means every source.
sources.title: Sources

unmeasurable.description: Per field, calls excluded because the filtered field was absent rather than different. These are not out of scope; they are unanswerable.
unmeasurable.title: Unmeasurable

ScopeResponse.title: ScopeResponse

total.description: Calls meeting ANY component, over distinct calls. Not the sum of the three — a call can be both a repeat and a process defect.

attribution.description: Complaints here by party, published as a split and never reduced.
attribution.title: Attribution

withoutComplaint.description: Calls here with no complaint tagged. Not the same as a complaint with no attribution, which the schema does not allow.
withoutComplaint.title: Withoutcomplaint

TrendsResponse.description:
Movement and emerging issues, over the same filtered calls as the scorecard.

Deliberately separate from `metrics`. Those are the Metrics sheet's own
figures, each gated on its own min n. This is a reading of movement
across windows, which the sheet does not define — so it is ours, and the
response keeps the two apart rather than presenting them as one list.

windowWeeks.description: Length of the movement window, and of the equal-length window before it that it is compared against. No workbook defines this; see MOVEMENT_WEEKS.
windowWeeks.title: Windowweeks

TrendsResponse.title: TrendsResponse

UnmeasurableResponse.description: Calls dropped by a filter for want of a value, not for differing.
UnmeasurableResponse.title: UnmeasurableResponse

WeekResponse.description: One week of the movement window.
WeekResponse.title: WeekResponse

WindowedFigureResponse.description: A figure with the period it was computed over.
WindowedFigureResponse.title: WindowedFigureResponse
